basis: S2-D34(6) (USER 2026-10-18); comparators read 2026-10-18
reason: eur_*, het_p and strict columns of the East Asian binary scans. CAD and stroke ship all of them (comparators GCST90132314 and GCST90104539 are CC0 on the Catalog). T2D ships eur_mr, eur_p, het_p and strict as derived single-instrument Wald results (principle P01, Tier 1); eur_af, a DIAMANTE per-variant frequency (DIAMANTE-EUR 2022 names no licence), stays withheld. The release gate (R11) judges these columns by the comparator declared in the file rule selector, not by every provider on the manifest licence_class.

A single-instrument Wald ratio with its SE (and its p, odds ratio, heterogeneity statistic and concordance class) is a derived per-pair result of the authors, not a provider value: it is computed from two summary effects at one variant and can be inverted to the outcome effect and its SE when the exposure effect at the variant also ships (FGFR4-T2D: the CKB exposure effect ships, so the TPMI effect and SE follow exactly). For UKB-PPP instruments the exposure beta is withheld (F01), so the outcome effect is not recoverable there. It is Tier 1 and ships with a citation of the source resource. The two summary effects themselves (the provider's beta, SE and frequency at the variant) are Tier 2 or 3 and follow the file rules.
